cd /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d14/with/t3-summary-feature/r1/packages/frai-gate && node dist/cli.js check /tmp/test-pass.md --summary && echo "Exit code: $?"

cat > /tmp/verify.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e

echo "=== FRAI Gate Summary Report Feature Verification ==="
echo ""

# Test 1: Help text
echo "✓ Test 1: Help text includes --summary flag"
node dist/cli.js help | grep -q "summary" && echo "  PASS: --summary found in help" || echo "  FAIL: --summary not in help"

# Test 2: Normal output (without summary)
echo ""
echo "✓ Test 2: Normal output works (without summary)"
if node dist/cli.js check /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d14/with/t3-summary-feature/r1/test-block.md 2>&1 | grep -q "FRAI Gate"; then
  echo "  PASS: Normal report output works"
else
  echo "  FAIL: Normal report output broken"
fi

# Test 3: Summary output format
echo ""
echo "✓ Test 3: Summary output format correct"
OUTPUT=$(node dist/cli.js check /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d14/with/t3-summary-feature/r1/test-block.md --summary)
if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -E "^BLOCK [0-7]/7"; then
  echo "  PASS: Output format correct: $OUTPUT"
else
  echo "  FAIL: Output format incorrect: $OUTPUT"
fi

# Test 4: Structure failure case
echo ""
echo "✓ Test 4: Structure failure handling"
OUTPUT=$(node dist/cli.js check /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d14/with/t3-summary-feature/r1/test-no-gate.md --summary)
if [ "$OUTPUT" = "BLOCK 0/7: structure" ]; then
  echo "  PASS: Structure failure case correct"
else
  echo "  FAIL: Expected 'BLOCK 0/7: structure' but got '$OUTPUT'"
fi

# Test 5: Exit codes
echo ""
echo "✓ Test 5: Exit codes preserved"
node dist/cli.js check /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d14/with/t3-summary-feature/r1/test-block.md --summary > /dev/null 2>&1 && EC1=0 || EC1=$?
if [ "$EC1" = "1" ]; then
  echo "  PASS: BLOCK exits with 1"
else
  echo "  FAIL: BLOCK should exit 1, got $EC1"
fi

# Test 6: JSON priority
echo ""
echo "✓ Test 6: --json overrides --summary"
OUTPUT=$(node dist/cli.js check /private/tmp/100-tricks-runs/d14/with/t3-summary-feature/r1/test-pass.md --summary --json)
if echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -q '"verdict"'; then
  echo "  PASS: JSON output used (--json has priority)"
else
  echo "  FAIL: Summary was used instead of JSON"
fi

echo ""
echo "=== All Verification Tests Complete ==="
EOF
bash /tmp/verify.sh
